label.ko: 급여 지급 직원당 "급여 처리" 프로세스 그룹 인건비
label.en: Personnel cost to perform the process group "process payroll" per employee paid

description.ko: (("근태 보고" 내부 비용 중 인건비 비율 × "근태 보고" 총비용 중 내부 비용 비율 × 0.0001 × "근태 보고" 총비용) + ("급여 관리" 내부 비용 중 인건비 비율 × "급여 관리" 총비용 중 내부 비용 비율 × 0.0001 × "급여 관리" 총비용) + ("급여세 처리" 내부 비용 중 인건비 비율 × "급여세 처리" 총비용 중 내부 비용 비율 × 0.0001 × "급여세 처리" 총비용)) / 급여 지급 총 직원 수
description.en: ((Percentage of internal costs of the process "report time" allocated to personnel costs * Percentage of total cost to perform the process "report time" allocated to internal costs * 0.0001 * Total cost to perform the process "report time") + (Percentage of internal costs of the process "manage pay" allocated to personnel costs * Percentage of total cost of the process "manage pay" allocated to internal costs * 0.0001 * Total cost to perform the process "manage pay") + (Percentage of internal costs of the process "process payroll taxes" allocated to personnel costs * Percentage of total cost to perform the process "process payroll taxes" allocated to internal costs * 0.0001 * Total cost to perform the process "process payroll taxes")) / Total number of employees paid

formula: ((Percentage of internal costs of the process "report time" allocated to personnel costs * Percentage of total cost to perform the process "report time" allocated to internal costs * 0.0001 * Total cost to perform the process "report time") + (Percentage of internal costs of the process "manage pay" allocated to personnel costs * Percentage of total cost of the process "manage pay" allocated to internal costs * 0.0001 * Total cost to perform the process "manage pay") + (Percentage of internal costs of the process "process payroll taxes" allocated to personnel costs * Percentage of total cost to perform the process "process payroll taxes" allocated to internal costs * 0.0001 * Total cost to perform the process "process payroll taxes")) / Total number of employees paid

label.ko: 급여 지급 직원당 "급여 처리" 프로세스 그룹 간접비 및 기타 비용
label.en: Overhead and other costs to perform the process group "process payroll" per employee paid

description.ko: (("근태 보고" 총비용 × "근태 보고" 총비용 중 내부 비용 비율 × "근태 보고" 내부 비용 중 간접비 및 기타 비용 비율 × 0.0001) + ("급여 관리" 총비용 × "급여 관리" 총비용 중 내부 비용 비율 × "급여 관리" 내부 비용 중 간접비 및 기타 비용 비율 × 0.0001) + ("급여세 처리" 총비용 × "급여세 처리" 총비용 중 내부 비용 비율 × "급여세 처리" 내부 비용 중 간접비 및 기타 비용 비율 × 0.0001)) / 급여 지급 총 직원 수
description.en: ((Total cost to perform the process "report time" * Percentage of total cost to perform the process "report time" allocated to internal costs * Percentage of internal costs of the process "report time" allocated to overhead and other costs * .0001) + (Total cost to perform the process "manage pay" * Percentage of total cost of the process "manage pay" allocated to internal costs * Percentage of internal costs of the process "manage pay" allocated to overhead and other costs * .0001) + (Total cost to perform the process "process payroll taxes" * Percentage of total cost to perform the process "process payroll taxes" allocated to internal costs * Percentage of internal costs of the process "process payroll taxes" allocated to overhead and other costs * .0001)) / Total number of employees paid

formula: ((Total cost to perform the process "report time" * Percentage of total cost to perform the process "report time" allocated to internal costs * Percentage of internal costs of the process "report time" allocated to overhead and other costs * .0001) + (Total cost to perform the process "manage pay" * Percentage of total cost of the process "manage pay" allocated to internal costs * Percentage of internal costs of the process "manage pay" allocated to overhead and other costs * .0001) + (Total cost to perform the process "process payroll taxes" * Percentage of total cost to perform the process "process payroll taxes" allocated to internal costs * Percentage of internal costs of the process "process payroll taxes" allocated to overhead and other costs * .0001)) / Total number of employees paid

label.ko: 급여 지급 직원당 "급여 처리" 프로세스 그룹 외주 비용
label.en: Outsourced cost to perform the process group "process payroll" per employee paid

description.ko: (("근태 보고" 총비용 × "근태 보고" 총비용 중 외부 비용 비율 × 0.01) + ("급여 관리" 총비용 × "급여 관리" 총비용 중 외부 비용 비율 × 0.01) + ("급여세 처리" 총비용 × "급여세 처리" 총비용 중 외부 비용 비율 × 0.01)) / 급여 지급 총 직원 수
description.en: ((Total cost to perform the process "report time" * Percentage of total cost to perform the process "report time" allocated to external costs * .01) + (Total cost to perform the process "manage pay" * Percentage of total cost to perform the process "manage pay" allocated to external costs * .01) + (Total cost to perform the process "process payroll taxes" * Percentage of total cost to perform the process "process payroll taxes" allocated to external costs * .01)) / Total number of employees paid

formula: ((Total cost to perform the process "report time" * Percentage of total cost to perform the process "report time" allocated to external costs * .01) + (Total cost to perform the process "manage pay" * Percentage of total cost to perform the process "manage pay" allocated to external costs * .01) + (Total cost to perform the process "process payroll taxes" * Percentage of total cost to perform the process "process payroll taxes" allocated to external costs * .01)) / Total number of employees paid

label.ko: 매출 10만 달러당 "급여 처리" 프로세스 그룹 시스템 비용

label.ko: 총 프로세스 그룹 비용 대비 "급여 처리" 프로세스 그룹 간접비 및 기타 비용 비율
label.en: Overhead and other costs to perform the process group "process payroll" as a percentage of total process group cost

description.ko: ((("근태 보고" 내부 비용 중 간접비 및 기타 비용 비율 × "근태 보고" 총비용 중 내부 비용 비율 × 0.0001 × "근태 보고" 총비용) + ("급여 관리" 내부 비용 중 간접비 및 기타 비용 비율 × "급여 관리" 총비용 중 내부 비용 비율 × 0.0001 × "급여 관리" 총비용) + ("급여세 처리" 내부 비용 중 간접비 및 기타 비용 비율 × "급여세 처리" 총비용 중 내부 비용 비율 × 0.0001 × "급여세 처리" 총비용)) / ("근태 보고" 총비용 + "급여 관리" 총비용 + "급여세 처리" 총비용)) × 100
description.en: (((Percentage of internal costs of the process "report time" allocated to overhead and other costs * Percentage of total cost to perform the process "report time" allocated to internal costs * 0.0001 * Total cost to perform the process "report time") + (Percentage of internal costs of the process "manage pay" allocated to overhead and other costs * Percentage of total cost of the process "manage pay" allocated to internal costs * 0.0001 * Total cost to perform the process "manage pay") + (Percentage of internal costs of the process "process payroll taxes" allocated to overhead and other costs * Percentage of total cost to perform the process "process payroll taxes" allocated to internal costs * 0.0001 * Total cost to perform the process "process payroll taxes")) / (Total cost to perform the process "report time" + Total cost to perform the process "manage pay" + Total cost to perform the process "process payroll taxes")) * 100

formula: (((Percentage of internal costs of the process "report time" allocated to overhead and other costs * Percentage of total cost to perform the process "report time" allocated to internal costs * 0.0001 * Total cost to perform the process "report time") + (Percentage of internal costs of the process "manage pay" allocated to overhead and other costs * Percentage of total cost of the process "manage pay" allocated to internal costs * 0.0001 * Total cost to perform the process "manage pay") + (Percentage of internal costs of the process "process payroll taxes" allocated to overhead and other costs * Percentage of total cost to perform the process "process payroll taxes" allocated to internal costs * 0.0001 * Total cost to perform the process "process payroll taxes")) / (Total cost to perform the process "report time" + Total cost to perform the process "manage pay" + Total cost to perform the process "process payroll taxes")) * 100

label.ko: 총 프로세스 그룹 비용 대비 "급여 처리" 프로세스 그룹 외주 비용 비율

description.ko: ((("근태 보고" 총비용 × "근태 보고" 총비용 중 외부 비용 비율 × 0.01) + ("급여 관리" 총비용 × "급여 관리" 총비용 중 외부 비용 비율 × 0.01) + ("급여세 처리" 총비용 × "급여세 처리" 총비용 중 외부 비용 비율 × 0.01)) / ("근태 보고" 총비용 + "급여 관리" 총비용 + "급여세 처리" 총비용)) × 100
description.en: (((Total cost to perform the process "report time" * Percentage of total cost to perform the process "report time" allocated to external costs * .01) + (Total cost to perform the process "manage pay" * Percentage of total cost to perform the process "manage pay" allocated to external costs * .01) + (Total cost to perform the process "process payroll taxes" * Percentage of total cost to perform the process "process payroll taxes" allocated to external costs * .01)) / (Total cost to perform the process "report time" + Total cost to perform the process "manage pay" + Total cost to perform the process "process payroll taxes")) * 100

formula: (((Total cost to perform the process "report time" * Percentage of total cost to perform the process "report time" allocated to external costs * .01) + (Total cost to perform the process "manage pay" * Percentage of total cost to perform the process "manage pay" allocated to external costs * .01) + (Total cost to perform the process "process payroll taxes" * Percentage of total cost to perform the process "process payroll taxes" allocated to external costs * .01)) / (Total cost to perform the process "report time" + Total cost to perform the process "manage pay" + Total cost to perform the process "process payroll taxes")) * 100

label.en: Personnel cost to perform the process group "perform general accounting and reporting" (excluding fixed assets) per $1,000 revenue

description.ko: ("정책 및 절차 관리" 인건비 + "일반 회계 수행" 인건비 + "재무 보고 수행" 인건비) / (총 비즈니스 엔티티 매출 × 0.001)
description.en: (Personnel cost to perform the process "manage policies and procedures" + Personnel cost to perform the process "perform general accounting" + Personnel cost to perform the process "perform financial reporting") / (Total business entity revenue * 0.001)

formula: (Personnel cost to perform the process "manage policies and procedures" + Personnel cost to perform the process "perform general accounting" + Personnel cost to perform the process "perform financial reporting") / (Total business entity revenue * 0.001)

description.en: (Systems cost to perform the process "manage policies and procedures" + Systems cost to perform the process "perform general accounting" + Systems cost to perform the process "perform financial reporting") / (Total business entity revenue * 0.00001)

formula: (Systems cost to perform the process "manage policies and procedures" + Systems cost to perform the process "perform general accounting" + Systems cost to perform the process "perform financial reporting") / (Total business entity revenue * 0.00001)

description.en: (Overhead cost to perform the process "manage policies and procedures" + Overhead cost to perform the process "perform general accounting" + Overhead cost to perform the process "perform financial reporting") / (Total business entity revenue * 0.00001)

description.ko: 마케팅 예산 중 디지털 마케팅 - 웹사이트 디자인·관리·최적화 배정 비율 + 디지털 마케팅 - 모바일 앱 디자인·관리·최적화 배정 비율 + 디지털 마케팅 - 디지털 콘텐츠 제작(예: 영상, 게임) 배정 비율 + 디지털 마케팅 - 가상 이벤트(예: 웨비나) 배정 비율 + 디지털 마케팅 - 검색엔진 최적화(SEO) 및 유료 검색/PPC 배정 비율 + 디지털 마케팅 - 온라인 광고(배너, 팝업, 외부 사이트 광고) 배정 비율 + 디지털 마케팅 - 앱 외 모바일 마케팅(예: 문자/멀티미디어 메시지) 배정 비율 + 디지털 마케팅 - 이메일 마케팅 배정 비율 + 디지털 마케팅 - 소셜미디어 인게이지먼트 배정 비율 + 디지털 마케팅 - 기타 배정 비율
description.en: Percentage of marketing budget allocated to digital marketing - website design, management, and optimization + Percentage of marketing budget allocated to digital marketing - mobile app design, management, and optimization + Percentage of marketing budget allocated to digital marketing - digital content creation (e.g., videos, games) + Percentage of marketing budget allocated to digital marketing - virtual events (e.g., webinars) + Percentage of marketing budget allocated to digital marketing - search engine optimization (seo) and paid search / pay per click (ppc) + Percentage of marketing budget allocated to digital marketing - online advertising (banners, pop-up ads, ads on external websites) + Percentage of marketing budget allocated to digital marketing - mobile marketing other than apps (e.g., text/multimedia messages) + Percentage of marketing budget allocated to digital marketing - email marketing + Percentage of marketing budget allocated to digital marketing - social media engagement + Percentage of marketing budget allocated to digital marketing - other

formula: Percentage of marketing budget allocated to digital marketing - website design, management, and optimization + Percentage of marketing budget allocated to digital marketing - mobile app design, management, and optimization + Percentage of marketing budget allocated to digital marketing - digital content creation (e.g., videos, games) + Percentage of marketing budget allocated to digital marketing - virtual events (e.g., webinars) + Percentage of marketing budget allocated to digital marketing - search engine optimization (seo) and paid search / pay per click (ppc) + Percentage of marketing budget allocated to digital marketing - online advertising (banners, pop-up ads, ads on external websites) + Percentage of marketing budget allocated to digital marketing - mobile marketing other than apps (e.g., text/multimedia messages) + Percentage of marketing budget allocated to digital marketing - email marketing + Percentage of marketing budget allocated to digital marketing - social media engagement + Percentage of marketing budget allocated to digital marketing - other

description.en: Percentage of marketing budget allocated to non-digital content creation + Percentage of marketing budget allocated to physical events (e.g., trade shows) + Percentage of marketing budget allocated to traditional media advertising and sponsorships - print media + Percentage of marketing budget allocated to traditional media advertising and sponsorships - television/radio media + Percentage of marketing budget allocated to traditional media advertising and sponsorships - other media (e.g., billboards) + Percentage of marketing budget allocated to non-digital direct marketing - direct postal mail + Percentage of marketing budget allocated to non-digital direct marketing - telemarketing
